purpose: Coordinator spot check of actual saved failures while game QA remains active; this is not final approval.

root.assessment: Saved failures identify requested omissions or a wrong rule. Examples include the crafting-piece clearing suit, shuffled hidden ruin stacks, Recruit quantity/roost, available operation names, Allied hit cap, and wrongly awarding ordinary removal VP for warriors. Keeping these failures and repairing/retesting is supported by the evidence.

oath-chronicles-of-empire-and-exile.assessment: Reader A reverses the People's Favor bank-distribution direction. Reader B adds the number of defense dice to the numerical defense result. Both are substantive contradictions, even though much of each answer is correct. No grading relaxation is justified.
